title: Settings
subtitle: Configure and manage your YA-WAMF instance
load_failed: Your settings could not be read, so nothing is shown for editing. Check that the YA-WAMF backend is running, then try again.
language_desc: The language of this screen, on this device. Notification messages use the language set in Notifications.

date_format.label: Date format
date_format.desc: Pick a default display format for dates.

time_format.label: Time format
time_format.desc: Choose a 12 hour or 24 hour clock.

video_circuit.title: Video analysis paused
video_circuit.message: Auto video analysis paused after {failures} failures.

data.maintenance_max_concurrent_help: Best practice is 1. Increase this only if you intentionally want backfill, taxonomy repair, timezone repair, or analyse-unknowns to overlap.
data.purge_confirm: Permanently delete {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}} and the BirdNET-Go audio older than {days} days? Favourites and each species' newest kept visits stay. This cannot be undone.
data.purge_confirm_counting: Counting the captures older than {days} days…
data.purge_confirm_uncounted: Permanently delete every capture and the BirdNET-Go audio older than {days} days? The number of captures could not be read. Favourites and each species' newest kept visits stay. This cannot be undone.
data.auto_cleanup_note: Clean-up runs when YA-WAMF starts and then every 24 hours.
data.cache_clips: Keep copies of Frigate's event clips
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshot_jpeg_q: Higher values keep more detail but create larger derived snapshot files.
data.cache_garden_share: Includes {size} kept for confirmed Garden animals
data.cache_cleanup_confirm: Delete cached photos and clips older than the retention period, and cached files that no longer belong to a capture? Favourites and each species' newest kept visits stay. This cannot be undone.
data.config_backup_desc: Export or restore the complete YA-WAMF configuration as JSON, including secrets.
data.config_backup_secret_warning: Backup files include tokens, webhooks, passwords, and auth secrets. Treat them like credentials.
data.config_backup_restore_note: After importing on a fresh install, run Missed visits to rebuild your history from Frigate.
data.config_backup_export_confirm: This backup includes secrets such as tokens, webhooks, passwords, and auth secrets. Store it somewhere private?
data.config_backup_import_confirm: Importing this backup replaces the current YA-WAMF configuration, including secrets. This installation keeps its own sign-in sessions and the key for its stored OAuth tokens. Continue?
data.config_backup_imported: Configuration backup imported ({count, plural, one {# section changed} other {# sections changed}}). Run a backfill when you are ready.
data.config_backup_invalid_json: The selected file is not valid JSON.
data.taxonomy_desc: Run this after changing the model or importing history, when visits show a scientific name or an old common name. It links each visit to its species' current names.
data.timezone_repair_desc: Run this when older visits show times an hour or more off. It checks each one against Frigate and corrects only whole-hour timezone offsets.
data.timezone_repair_preview_found: {count, plural, one {# capture can be repaired.} other {# captures can be repaired.}}
data.timezone_repair_preview_none: No safe timezone repairs were found.
data.timezone_repair_confirm: Apply safe timezone repairs to the previewed captures?
data.timezone_repair_apply_success: Repaired {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}}.
data.backfill_desc: Run this when Frigate recorded visits while YA-WAMF was not running. It reads Frigate's history for the window you choose and adds the visits that were missed.
data.backfill_validation_select_both: Select both start and end dates.
data.backfill_validation_order: Start date must be before or equal to end date.
data.batch_analysis_long_desc: Run this after changing the model. It analyses the clip of every Unknown bird visit again in the background; visits without a clip are skipped.
data.batch_analysis_circuit_open: Circuit breaker open (Paused due to failures)
data.cleanup_success: Cleanup complete. Deleted {count, plural, one {# old capture} other {# old captures}}.
data.cache_cleanup_success: Cache cleanup complete! Deleted {snapshots} snapshots, {clips} clips ({freed} freed).
data.cache_high_quality_event_snapshots_help: After an event ends, choose the clearest main-stream frame and best crop available. The full frame is kept when a reliable crop cannot be made.
data.cache_crop_detector_ready_help: Frigate’s tracking hints and the bird finders are tried automatically.
data.cache_crop_fallback_ready_help: Frigate tracking hints are used automatically; detector crops join in when a model is installed.
data.taxonomy_sync_error: The species name sync could not start. Check that YA-WAMF is running, then try again.
data.frigate_missing_behavior: When Frigate no longer has the event/media
data.frigate_missing_behavior_mark: Mark missing and keep local data
data.frigate_missing_behavior_delete: Delete records YA-WAMF has no photo for
data.frigate_missing_behavior_note: This choice is applied during manual scans and scheduled checks. Choose “Mark missing and keep local data” when YA-WAMF should keep its captures longer than Frigate keeps the events. A record whose photo YA-WAMF still holds is never deleted; it is marked missing instead.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm_delete: Visits whose Frigate event, clip or snapshot is gone are deleted from YA-WAMF, with their video, unless YA-WAMF still holds their photo. Those, and favourites, are kept and marked missing. How many of each is not known until the scan has run. A deletion cannot be undone.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm_mark: Visits whose Frigate event, clip or snapshot is gone are marked missing. Their photos and records are kept. Nothing is deleted.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm_keep: Visits whose Frigate event, clip or snapshot is gone are left unchanged. Nothing is deleted.
data.purge_missing_media_confirm_unsaved: Your unsaved choice applies only after Save.
data.media_integrity_note: Re-checks a batch of captures against Frigate every few hours and applies the upstream-missing behaviour above. It never changes anything while Frigate is unreachable, and a long history takes several runs to work through.
data.purge_missing_scan_success: Scan complete: checked {checked}, missing {missing}, deleted {deleted}, marked missing {marked}, kept {kept}, restored {restored}. Unable to check {errors}; their saved state was preserved.
data.clear_favorites_desc: Removes every favourite marker and its archived photo and clip. Captures and cached media stay.
data.clear_favorites_confirm: Remove all favourite markers and their archived photos and clips? The visits stay in history. This cannot be undone.
data.clear_favorites_success: Removed {count, plural, one {# favourite marker} other {# favourite markers}}.
data.archive_failed_count: {count} could not be archived. Open the visit to try again.
data.per_species_minimum: Keep photos of each species' newest visits
data.per_species_minimum_help: That many of each species' newest visits keep their photos after they leave the history window, so a rare bird keeps its pictures. Video is not kept longer. The storage limit still applies.
data.per_species_maximum: Limit visits per species with photos and video
data.per_species_maximum_help: A species' visits beyond this number lose their photos and video, oldest first. The visits stay in history. Favourites don't count.
data.bird_scan_mode_help: Applies to manual and automatic scans. Standard uses less CPU. Intensive also searches tiles in large frames and classifies more crop choices. Neither guarantees every bird is found.
data.cache_clips_help: Frigate already keeps these. Copies survive Frigate deleting them, at about the size of the clip each.
data.cache_always_kept: Photos, full-visit clips and previews are kept with their visits until the history window or the storage limit removes them.
data.cache_unavailable: The media folder can't be written, so photos and video are not being kept. Check the folder's permissions; system checks show the error.
data.cache_high_quality_storage_note: Each visit then also keeps full-resolution frames, often several MB, so set a storage limit if space is tight.
data.automatic_multi_bird_scan_help: Off by default to reduce processing. Normal bird identification and the target bird’s crop continue, and existing findings are kept. Use Find more birds on a photograph whenever you need a scan. When enabled, scans run on retained whole frames.
data.purge_disabled_forever: Nothing to purge: history is kept forever.
data.purge_disabled_none: No captures are older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_counting: Counting the captures older than {days} days…
data.retention_shrink_note: Saving this permanently deletes {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}} older than {days} days at the next cleanup (on restart, then every 24 hours).
data.retention_shrink_uncounted: Saving this permanently deletes every capture older than {days} days at the next cleanup (on restart, then every 24 hours).
data.retention_shrink_manual: Automatic cleanup is off, so saving deletes nothing by itself. “Purge old records” would then delete {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}} older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_manual_uncounted: Automatic cleanup is off, so saving deletes nothing by itself. “Purge old records” would then delete every capture older than {days} days.
data.retention_shrink_kept_floor: Favourites and the newest {floor, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}} of each species are kept. Older BirdNET-Go audio and Garden animal records are deleted too.
data.retention_shrink_kept: Favourites are kept. Older BirdNET-Go audio and Garden animal records are deleted too.
data.retention_confirm_button: Save and delete {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}}
data.history_summary: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, the oldest from {oldest}.
data.history_due: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} older than the saved window and will go at the next clean-up.
data.missing_media_desc: Frigate deletes old events on its own schedule. This decides what YA-WAMF keeps when one is gone.
data.maintenance_jobs_desc: By default each kind of job above runs one at a time, which keeps it from competing with bird identification.
data.storage_limit: Limit the space photos and video use
data.per_species_maximum_count: Visits per species with photos and video
data.storage_limit_invalid: Enter a size from 0.5 to 1024 GB. The limit stays at {size} GB until you do.
data.storage_limit_invalid_short: Enter a storage limit from 0.5 to 1024 GB.
data.storage_policy_size_limit: When photos and video pass {size} GB, the oldest go first.
data.storage_policy_history_only: No size limit: photos and video stay until the history window removes their visits.
data.storage_policy_species_cap: {count, plural, one {Each species keeps photos and video only for its newest visit.} other {Each species keeps photos and video only for its newest # visits.}}
data.storage_policy_species_floor: {count, plural, one {Each species' newest visit keeps its photos past the history window.} other {Each species' newest # visits keep their photos past the history window.}}
data.storage_policy_favourites: Favourites and their archive are always kept.

security.https_warning: Sign-in is on, but this page is served over HTTP, so passwords and sessions can be read on the network. Serve YA-WAMF over HTTPS, for example behind your reverse proxy.

connection.mqtt_title: The broker Frigate publishes its events to. YA-WAMF listens there for new visits.

tabs.refused_note: Has a value the last save refused

status.title: Status
status.not_read: Not measured yet: the status has not been read.
status.stale: This reading is out of date: no newer one has arrived.
status.display_note: Nothing here depends on another service. Theme, text size, language and the accessibility choices on this device change at once. Units and the defaults for everyone wait for Save.

purpose.mqtt: The broker carries Frigate's events to YA-WAMF, so each new visit arrives.
purpose.frigate: Frigate records the cameras. YA-WAMF reads each visit's photos and video from it.
purpose.classifier: The model names the bird in each visit.
purpose.finder: The bird finder picks each bird out of a busy photo before it is named. It is optional.
purpose.audio: BirdNET-Go listens for birdsong, so a visit can be matched with the calls heard.
purpose.storage: Photos and video are kept in the media folder on this install.
purpose.notifications: Notifications go out on your channels when a visit earns one.

mqtt.connecting: Connecting to the broker for the first time since YA-WAMF started.
mqtt.disconnected: The broker is not connected, so no new visits can be recorded.
mqtt.not_configured: No broker is set, so no visits can be recorded.
mqtt.stopped: The MQTT service is not running, so no new visits can be recorded.
mqtt.pressure_high: Events arrive faster than YA-WAMF handles them, so some wait.
mqtt.pressure_critical: Events arrive much faster than YA-WAMF handles them, so many wait.
mqtt.backlog: Events are waiting their turn to be handled.
mqtt.frigate_topic_silent: Connected, but nothing has come from Frigate for a while.

frigate.reachable: Frigate answers, and no camera is reported offline.
frigate.unreachable: Frigate does not answer, so new visits cannot be saved.
frigate.unchecked: Frigate has not been asked yet since YA-WAMF started.
frigate.cameras_offline: Frigate answers, but a camera is offline.

classifier.model_missing: The chosen model is not on this install, so no bird can be named.
classifier.unmeasured: The model has not reported since YA-WAMF started.
classifier.model_not_loaded: The model's files are here, but it did not load.
classifier.runtime_failed: The model stopped working. The runtime report under More options says why.
classifier.recovering: The model is starting again after it stopped.
classifier.live_degraded: Naming new visits is slower than it should be.

finder.ready: The bird finder is downloaded and runs where it should.
finder.unmeasured: The bird finder has not reported since YA-WAMF started.
finder.cpu_fallback: The bird finder runs on the processor, because its chosen device failed.
finder.none_selected: No bird finder is chosen. It is optional.
finder.not_downloaded: The chosen bird finder is not downloaded, so it runs nowhere yet.

audio.hearing: Calls have arrived from BirdNET-Go since YA-WAMF started.
audio.nothing_heard: No call has arrived since YA-WAMF started. BirdNET-Go may simply have heard nothing yet.
audio.broker_down: Calls come over MQTT, and the broker is not connected.

storage.writable: The media folder can be written.
storage.not_writable: The media folder cannot be written, so photos and video are not kept.

notifications.ready: A channel is on, and no alert has been dropped since YA-WAMF started.
notifications.none_enabled: No channel is on, so no alert is sent.
notifications.dropped: Some alerts were dropped before they could be sent.

test.not_kept: Test results aren't kept. Run the test to check now.
test.failed: Tested at {time}: it did not work. Run it again to see why.
test.failed_subject: {subject} tested at {time}: it did not work. Run it again to see why.
test.passed_unsaved: Tested at {time} with the values on this page, not saved yet: it worked.
test.failed_unsaved: Tested at {time} with the values on this page, not saved yet: it did not work. Run it again to see why.
test.passed_subject_unsaved: {subject} tested at {time} with the values on this page, not saved yet: it worked.
test.failed_subject_unsaved: {subject} tested at {time} with the values on this page, not saved yet: it did not work. Run it again to see why.

status.access_note: Nothing here depends on a measured connection. Sign-in, guest access and telemetry each say here whether they are on.

more.title: More options
more.cameras: Frigate details, image source and clips
more.identification: Blocked species, the range filter, video checks, hardware and Beta features
more.storage: When Frigate loses a visit, and the jobs that repair or fill in the history
more.display: Date and time format, how birds are named, the Explorer layout, fonts and colours, accessibility defaults for everyone, and units
more.notifications: Cooldown, language, the link and the species filter
more.integrations: Where species pages get their information

debug.strict_non_finite_output: Discard results the model could not compute
debug.strict_non_finite_output_desc: On, a result that is not a number is thrown away and the model is restarted. Turn it off only while you look into a model fault.

ai.pricing_not_configured: Set prices under Pricing and prompt templates for an accurate cost.
ai.cost_unpriced_models: No price is set for {models}. Add one under Pricing and prompt templates.
ai.cost_coverage_partial: Covers {priced} of {total, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}. Not priced, so not included: {models}.
ai.cost_coverage_all: {total, plural, one {Covers the # request made.} other {Covers all # requests.}}
ai.cost_no_usage: No requests, so nothing to cost.
ai.clear_usage_confirm: Clear the AI usage history? The counts and costs so far are deleted and cannot be brought back.
ai.pricing_help: Override the default token pricing for cost estimation. Format: an array of objects with provider, model, inputPer1M, and outputPer1M.
ai.test_subtitle: Checks the same multi-frame format the AI analysis of a record uses.
ai.test_multiframe_ok: {count, plural, one {# JPEG frame was accepted in one request.} other {# JPEG frames were accepted in one request.}}
ai.test_skipped: Not run because an earlier stage failed.
ai.test_probe_note: This sends five representative 1280×720 JPEG frames, matching the count, dimensions, and approximate payload size of a real analysis request.
ai.test_network_error: The diagnostic request could not reach YA-WAMF.
ai.prompt_style_desc: Choosing a style replaces the three templates below with its wording. Save changes keeps it.
ai.test_needs_key: Add an API key from your provider to test the connection. Each provider issues its own:

birdnet.title: BirdNET-Go
birdnet.toggle_label: Matches bird calls BirdNET-Go hears to camera visits, so a visit can be confirmed by sound.
birdnet.internal_url_help: Backend-only URL used to fetch spectrogram backgrounds, such as the Docker network address.
birdnet.external_url_help: Public HTTPS URL opened by dashboard links. Falls back to the internal URL when empty.
birdnet.audio_buffer_help: How long to keep calls for matching with visits (1 to 168 hours)
birdnet.match_window_help: Time window for matching audio with visual (±5-3600 seconds)
birdnet.sensor_mapping_empty: No cameras detected. Check Frigate connection.
birdnet.sensor_mapping_help: Map each Frigate camera to BirdNET source names (stable `nm` / display names). For multi-stream cameras, you can enter multiple names separated by commas.
birdnet.source_discovery_error: Failed to load recent BirdNET source names.
birdnet.source_discovery_empty: No BirdNET-Go source names seen yet. Wait until a call is heard, then reload Settings.
birdnet.source_discovery_add_to: {source}, heard {time}. Select it to add it to {camera}.
birdnet.test_subtitle: Confirms BirdNET-Go can be reached, the MQTT broker accepts a message, and a test call is received and stored.

inaturalist.title: iNaturalist
inaturalist.toggle_label: Lets you send a visit to iNaturalist as an observation, from its record.
inaturalist.oauth_desc: Connect your iNaturalist account to submit visits you have confirmed.
inaturalist.app_owner_note: Requires iNaturalist App Owner approval (account 2+ months old and 10 improving IDs in the last month).
inaturalist.popup_blocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow popups for this site and try again.

ebird.title: eBird
ebird.toggle_label: Shows nearby sightings, seasonality and rarity from eBird on species pages.
ebird.api_key_desc: Required to fetch recent sightings and notable birds.
ebird.export_csv_desc: Download your records in eBird Record Format to import by hand.
ebird.export_range_help: Leave both blank to export every record, or choose a date range that includes both days.
ebird.export_range_error: From date must be on or before the To date.
ebird.export_everything_label: Export every record, not only a date range
ebird.export_everything_help: Turn this on to export every record. The date range is then not used.

birdweather.title: BirdWeather
birdweather.toggle_label: Sends each named visit to your BirdWeather station.
birdweather.token_desc: Available in your station settings under "BirdWeather Token".
birdweather.test_subtitle: Checks that your station token is accepted by BirdWeather.

ha_weather.title: Home Assistant weather
ha_weather.toggle_label: Record the weather from your own sensors instead of the forecast API. A sensor that cannot answer reads as unknown, never as a forecast.
ha_weather.base_url_desc: The address this server can reach, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123
ha_weather.token_desc: Created in Home Assistant under your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens.
ha_weather.entity_desc: The general source, e.g. weather.home. Leave empty to rely on sensor overrides alone.
ha_weather.overrides_desc: A sensor named here outranks the weather entity for its one reading. When it cannot answer, that reading is unknown.
ha_weather.test_subtitle: Fetches the current readings that would be stored with a visit.
ha_weather.illuminance_desc: Optional. A light sensor that reports lx, e.g. sensor.feeder_illuminance. Its reading is stored with each new visit. When it cannot answer, no light level is stored.
ha_weather.illuminance_invalid: This is not an entity id. Use the id Home Assistant shows for the sensor, such as sensor.feeder_illuminance.
ha_weather.stage_illuminance: Light level from the illuminance entity
ha_weather.illuminance_invalid_entity_id: {entity} is not a Home Assistant entity id. Use one such as sensor.feeder_illuminance.
ha_weather.illuminance_unreachable: Home Assistant did not return {entity}. Check the entity id, the URL and the token.
ha_weather.illuminance_not_illuminance: {entity} is not an illuminance sensor. Choose a sensor with the illuminance device class or the unit lx.
ha_weather.illuminance_unavailable: {entity} is unknown or unavailable in Home Assistant right now. Visits record no light level until it answers.
ha_weather.illuminance_not_numeric: {entity} did not report a number, so no light level is recorded.
ha_weather.illuminance_out_of_range: {entity} reported a value outside 0 to 200,000 lx, so it is not recorded.
ha_weather.illuminance_no_answer: The test returned no light reading.

integrations.elsewhere_pipeline: Frigate and the MQTT broker are how visits arrive, so they are set in {section}.
integrations.elsewhere_location: The weather, eBird, iNaturalist and the range filter all start from your feeder’s location, also set in {section}. The weather itself comes from Open-Meteo and needs no setup.

state.no_test: On and set up. It has no connection test.
state.not_tested: On and set up. Not tested yet; test results aren’t kept between visits.
state.failed: On, but the test failed at {time}: {reason}
state.needs_inaturalist_app: add the application ID and secret
state.needs_audio_topic: add the MQTT topic BirdNET-Go publishes to
state.needs_ha_entity: choose a weather entity or a sensor

enrichment.title: Enrichment sources
enrichment.desc: Sources are selected automatically based on your integrations.
enrichment.needs_ebird: Not shown: needs an eBird API key
enrichment.ebird_hint: Nearby sightings, seasonality and rarity appear on species pages once eBird is on with an API key.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.desc: Ask for a username and password before anyone can see everything or change settings.
auth.proxy_trust_note: Proxy headers are trusted from all hosts by default. If you run behind a reverse proxy, set trusted proxy hosts to prevent spoofed client IPs.
auth.trusted_proxies_desc: Add your reverse proxy container names or IPs (e.g., nginx-rp, cloudflare-tunnel, 172.19.0.10). Docker DNS names work when services share a network.
auth.trusted_proxies_suggested_note: These are suggestions only. Save will keep the default (trust all) unless you accept or edit them.
auth.trusted_proxies_empty: No trusted proxies configured (all proxies trusted).
auth.avatar_desc: Shown beside your name in the sidebar. It is stored as a small square picture; nothing else from the file is kept.
auth.avatar_too_large: That file is over 8 MB. Choose a smaller picture.
auth.avatar_failed: That file could not be used as a picture. Try a JPEG or PNG.
auth.off_status: Sign-in is off, so anyone who can open this address can see everything and change every setting.

public_access.title: Public access
public_access.desc: Lets guests see your visits without signing in. They can never change settings.
public_access.show_camera_names_desc: Guests see each camera’s name. Off shows a generic label.
public_access.show_ai_conversation_desc: Allow guests to read AI conversations on records
public_access.allow_clip_downloads_desc: Allow guests to download full video clips
public_access.share_base_url_desc: If set, new share links use this public base URL instead of the detected request host.
public_access.show_audio_desc: BirdNET calls, spectrograms and audio clips. Off means guests see no audio at all.
public_access.show_snapshots_desc: Snapshots and thumbnails. Off means guests see placeholders instead of images.
public_access.show_clips_desc: Video clips and their previews. Off means guests cannot play video at all; the download switch below only controls saving the file.
public_access.location_precision_desc: Approximate rounds the location to about 10 km before any feature a guest can see uses it, so sharing your feeder does not publish your address.
public_access.needs_auth: Guest access only means something once sign-in is on: until then, everyone already has full access. Turn on sign-in first.

accessibility.title: Accessibility options
accessibility.high_contrast_desc: A black background with white and yellow text, in place of the light or dark theme.
accessibility.dyslexia_font_desc: Sets all text in the OpenDyslexic typeface.
accessibility.dyslexia_font_latin_only: It has Latin letters only, so text in this language stays as it is.
accessibility.reduced_motion_desc: Stops animations and transitions. Your device's reduce-motion setting is always followed as well.
accessibility.live_announcements_desc: Reads each new bird out to a screen reader as it arrives.
accessibility.device_scope: These change at once, in this browser only, and need no saving. Until you set one here, this device follows the default for everyone under More options.
accessibility.defaults_scope: Guests and devices with no choice of their own follow these, once you save. A device with its own choice keeps it. Until you save, this device previews the ones it follows.
accessibility.previewing_default: Previewing the unsaved default for everyone ({state})
accessibility.own_choice: Set on this device. The default for everyone is {state}.

frigate.title: Frigate NVR
frigate.full_visit_clips_desc: Serve a longer clip from Frigate’s recordings around each visit.
frigate.full_visit_supported: {count, plural, one {Continuous coverage is ready for the selected camera.} other {Continuous coverage is ready for all # selected cameras.}}
frigate.full_visit_unavailable: Capability information is unavailable right now.
frigate.full_visit_retention: Guaranteed continuous retention: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
frigate.full_visit_reason_config_unavailable: Frigate config could not be read.
frigate.full_visit_reason_no_matching_cameras: No selected cameras match the current Frigate config.
frigate.full_visit_reason_recordings_disabled: Recording is disabled for the selected cameras. Enable recording and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_continuous_retention_d: Frigate is not retaining a continuous timeline. Set record.continuous.days to at least 1; event-only clips can start late or end early.
frigate.full_visit_reason_record_stream_missing: A selected camera has no recording stream. Add record to its FFmpeg input roles and retain at least one continuous day.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_disabled: A selected camera is disabled in Frigate. Enable it before using full-visit clips.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_not_found: A selected camera is no longer present in Frigate. Sync the camera list and review your selection.
frigate.full_visit_reason_partial_camera_coverag: Only some selected cameras have continuous recording coverage. Full-visit clips stay unavailable until every selected camera is covered.
frigate.full_visit_reason_camera_configuration_i: The selected cameras have more than one recording configuration issue. Review each camera below.
frigate.full_visit_reason_retention_unknown: Continuous recording retention could not be determined. Validate the Frigate recording config before enabling full visits.
frigate.external_url_desc: The address your browser uses to open Frigate when it differs from the server address above. Used for the “open in Frigate” link on a record.
frigate.ingest_labels_desc: Comma-separated. Add the labels your Frigate model uses for birds (e.g. bird, duck, goose); everything listed flows through the bird identification pipeline.
frigate.classification_image_source_desc: Frigate’s snapshot is faster. A recording frame can show more detail when the recording stream is larger than the detect stream and shows the same view. It does not guarantee a better identification.
frigate.classification_image_recording_cost: Frigate decodes one recording frame for each visit, and YA-WAMF downloads and processes it.
frigate.classification_image_recording_fallback: Needs retained recordings and the clean snapshot copy in Frigate ({setting}). Recording frames usually become available 10 to 15 seconds later. After the selected delay, unavailable frames are normally retried for up to 18 seconds before Frigate’s snapshot is used. Smaller or differently shaped recording frames also use the snapshot.
frigate.classification_image_recording_scope: Applies to new visits, including past events imported as missed visits. Saving does not fetch past events or change existing photos; reclassification prefers saved photos.
frigate.test_subtitle: Checks that the Frigate API answers and that the MQTT broker accepts a publish.
frigate.recording_frame_delay_desc: Wait 1 to 120 seconds after the first snapshot moment. Use the latest tracked snapshot metadata received during that wait. Identification and notifications arrive later. This does not wait for every event to end or reclassify saved visits.
frigate.stage_frigate_next: Check the server URL in {section}, and that Frigate is running.
frigate.stage_mqtt_next: Check the broker address, port and sign-in in {section}.

cameras.title: Cameras to watch
cameras.preview_missing_url: No preview URL available for this camera.
cameras.nest_dedupe_help: Counts repeat visits by the same species to a nest camera as one per N minutes.
cameras.role_feeder_help: Feeder: each Frigate event is a visit of its own.
cameras.role_nest_help: Nest box: a bird that stays in view counts once per window below instead of once per event, so a sitting parent does not flood the feed.
cameras.preview_needs_url: Enter the Frigate URL above to preview a camera.
cameras.watch_desc: Choose which Frigate cameras are watched for birds.
cameras.watch_desc_garden: Choose what each Frigate camera is watched for: birds, Garden animals or both.
cameras.every_camera_on: Every Frigate camera is watched for birds, including cameras added to Frigate later.
cameras.every_camera_off: Only the cameras chosen here are watched for birds. A camera added to Frigate later is not watched until you choose it.
cameras.garden_beta_hint: To watch for Garden animals as well, turn on Garden animals in Settings → Identifying birds.
cameras.list_loading: Reading the camera list from Frigate…
cameras.list_unread: The camera list could not be read from Frigate. Saved cameras are shown; choose Sync cameras to try again.
cameras.none_found_help: Frigate reported no cameras. Check the Frigate URL above, then choose Sync cameras.
cameras.not_found_help: Frigate does not list this camera now. Its choices are kept until you change them; choose Off to remove it.
cameras.blocked_last_bird_camera: At least one camera must watch for birds, so birds stay on for this camera.
cameras.blocked_camera_list_unread: Every camera watches for birds. Sync cameras from Frigate before turning birds off for one camera.
cameras.sync_help: The list comes from Frigate. Sync again after adding a camera there.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.desc: Optional, anonymous usage telemetry to help improve YA-WAMF. Disabled by default.
telemetry.privacy_notice: No images, clips, audio, visits, user names, emails or API keys are collected.
telemetry.includes_value: Model type, enabled integrations, notification channels, enrichment mode, access flags
telemetry.geography_value: Approx. country derived from request headers (IP not stored)
telemetry.health_desc: Share deduped backend health issues once per day so recurring failures can be debugged.
telemetry.health_includes_value: Issue fingerprints, component/reason codes, severity, counts, coarse runtime settings, and sanitized context
telemetry.appreciation_tooltip: If you can, please enable telemetry. It helps me understand how YA-WAMF is used and guides improvements.

email.title: Email notifications
email.desc: Sends each alert by email, from Gmail, Outlook or your own mail server.
email.oauth_desc: Secure authentication using Gmail or Outlook
email.only_on_end_desc: Send email notifications only when Frigate publishes the end event (treated as an update).
email.oauth_app_credentials_desc: Your Google or Microsoft OAuth app credentials, required before connecting an account.
email.test_needs: Enter the recipient address to send a test.

notifications.audio_only_desc: Only alert when a BirdNET call confirms the visit.
notifications.mode_desc: Pick how and when notifications are sent. Advanced lets you override the exact triggers.
notifications.mode_final_desc: Notify only when the event ends and video analysis (if enabled) is complete.
notifications.mode_standard_desc: Notify once a visit is confirmed.
notifications.mode_realtime_desc: Notify early, and allow update notifications as the visit goes on.
notifications.cooldown_desc: After an alert, wait this long before sending another.
notifications.species_filter_none_desc: Notify for all species that pass the other filters.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_desc: Notify for everything except the species below.
notifications.species_filter_whitelist_desc: Notify only for the species below.
notifications.species_filter_blacklist_list: Do not notify for these species
notifications.species_filter_search_placeholder: Search birds by common or scientific name
notifications.notification_language_desc: Language used for the text of notification messages sent to all channels
notifications.instance_url_desc: Public address of this YA-WAMF install. Notifications link back to the record here; leave blank for no link.
notifications.link_opens_yawamf_desc: The visit in the Explorer, with its clip, snapshots and identification.
notifications.link_opens_frigate_desc: The same tracked object in Frigate's Explore page.
notifications.link_opens_frigate_req: Needs Frigate 0.15 or newer and the Frigate public URL, set in Settings → Cameras & connection.
notifications.link_frigate_url_missing: The Frigate public URL is not set, so notifications carry no link until it is.
notifications.link_preview_others: Discord title, Pushover and email use the same address.
notifications.link_preview_none: none yet, so Telegram messages have no button.

sentence.custom_hint: Your own triggers, set with the switches under this sentence. At most one alert per visit.
sentence.species_all_but: {count, plural, one {all but # species} other {all but # species}}
sentence.species_jump: Species filter: {summary}. Go to the species filter.

notifications.test_failed: The test message could not be sent.
notifications.test_subtitle: Sends one test message using the current settings for this channel.

garden.enabled_help: One alert per visit when an animal is named automatically or you accept its species. Takes effect when you save changes.
garden.use_bird_help: The Notifications channels that are switched on and set up.
garden.choose_help: Uses saved credentials; their bird switches can stay off.
garden.bird_none: No bird channel is switched on and set up, so no Garden alert can be sent. Switch one on in Notifications, or choose channels here.
garden.choose_one: Choose at least one channel to deliver Garden alerts.
garden.credentials: No saved credentials for {channels}, so Garden alerts there will fail. Add them in Notifications.
garden.include_photo_help: Attaches the saved animal crop, or the capture photo when there is no crop. Only confirmed animals are sent, so it is a photo you or the automatic check accepted. Text only if no photo can be read.
garden.privacy: Sends the animal name, the camera, the time it was seen and, if chosen, the photo to these services. The link opens this capture here; a guest can open it only while public access shares it.
garden.rules: Sent within five minutes of the name being decided, for visits up to two hours old, so turning alerts on never replays history. One attempt per channel per visit; failed or uncertain sends are not retried.
garden.status: Saved delivery attempts. Accepted by channel: {sent}. Failed: {failed}. Unconfirmed: {unknown}. Skipped: {skipped}.
garden.status_after_apply: Delivery status appears once Garden is switched on and saved.

notifications.channels_desc: Where alerts go. Turn a channel on to set it up.
notifications.include_snapshot_desc: Sends the visit’s snapshot with each alert. Off sends the words alone.

custom_rules.title: Custom rules
custom_rules.active: Your own triggers. A visit sends at most one alert, so these cannot repeat an alert as a visit changes: choose every update in the sentence above for that.
custom_rules.desc: These switches take effect only with custom rules. The other choices in the sentence above set their own triggers and ignore them. Choose custom rules there to use these.
custom_rules.on_insert_desc: Sends the alert when Frigate first reports the visit, if its name is sure enough by then.
custom_rules.on_update: Later, if no alert has gone
custom_rules.on_update_desc: Sends the one alert when Frigate later updates the visit, if none went at the start: the switch above is off, or the name was not sure enough yet. It never sends a second alert.
custom_rules.delay_video_desc: Holds the alert until the video check has confirmed the name, or for the seconds below if it never answers. Needs video checks on, in {section}.

notifications.garden_off: Garden animal alerts are set here once Garden animals is turned on, under Beta features in {section}.

discord.title: Discord notifications
discord.desc: Posts each alert to a Discord channel through its webhook.
discord.test_needs: Enter the webhook URL to send a test.

pushover.title: Pushover notifications
pushover.desc: Sends each alert to your phone through the Pushover app.
pushover.device_hint: Comma-separated device names. Leave blank to send to all active devices.
pushover.test_needs: Enter the user key and API token to send a test.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.desc: Sends each alert to a Telegram chat through your bot.
telegram.test_needs: Enter the bot token and chat ID to send a test.

location.title: Location
location.card_desc: The weather recorded with each visit, nearby eBird sightings, the range filter and observations sent to iNaturalist all start from here.
location.weather_unit_system_desc: Use one consistent unit system for temperature, wind, precipitation, and distances.
location.map_empty: No coordinates configured yet. Set a latitude and longitude (or enable auto-detect) to see the map.
location.map_help: Showing the location currently configured for weather, hotspots, and observations.
location.mode_help: Auto-detect uses your IP/timezone. Manual lets you pin exact coordinates for weather, eBird hotspots, and observation submissions.
location.resolve_empty: No place name available for these coordinates

danger.title: Delete data
danger.subtitle: Each of these deletes something for good. Each asks before it does anything.
danger.reset_desc: Deletes every capture, every cached photo and clip, every archived favourite, and the daily totals that keep older Leaderboard history.
danger.confirm: Delete all {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}}, hidden ones included, every cached photo and clip, every archived favourite, and the daily totals that keep older Leaderboard history? This cannot be undone.
danger.confirm_changed: The number of captures changed while this was open. Delete all {count, plural, one {# capture} other {# captures}}, hidden ones included, every cached photo and clip, every archived favourite, and the daily totals that keep older Leaderboard history? This cannot be undone.
danger.confirm_counting: Counting the captures this would delete…
danger.confirm_uncounted: Delete all captures, every cached photo and clip, every archived favourite, and the daily totals that keep older Leaderboard history? The number of captures could not be read. This cannot be undone.
danger.clear_feedback_desc: YA-WAMF uses the species you corrected to adjust its scores for each camera. Deleting the corrections returns it to the model's own scores.
danger.clear_feedback_hint: Captures and photos stay. New corrections start the adjustment again.
danger.clear_feedback_confirm: Delete your identification corrections? Scores go back to the model's own, and captures and photos stay. This cannot be undone.

detection.floor_help: Below this score, a photo is not kept at all. Between the two, the visit is kept as Unknown bird for you to name.
detection.trust_frigate_desc: Skip internal classification if Frigate identified species
detection.write_frigate_sublabel_desc: Append YA-WAMF species labels to Frigate event sublabels
detection.auto_video_desc: Automatically run deep video reclassification for every event
detection.video_retry_note: Retries use exponential backoff to wait for Frigate clip finalization.
detection.naming_scientific_sub: Only show scientific names. Hides common names.
detection.blocked_species_picker_desc: A blocked species is never saved as a visit. Search by common or scientific name; blocking a family or genus blocks every species in it. Older labels, listed apart, still apply until you remove them.
detection.inference_provider_desc: Lists only the devices this image includes, this host has and the model in use supports.
detection.provider_saved_unavailable: Saved: {provider}. It is not among the devices this model can use here now, so another device is used. Check devices on this host, or choose Auto.
detection.execution_mode_desc: Isolated workers, the default, restart safely if a classification stalls or crashes; each worker holds its own copy of the model. In-process shares one copy inside the app: less memory, less isolation.
detection.execution_mode_worker_plan: Resolved for this install: {live} live and {background} background worker processes, each with its own copy of the model.
detection.execution_mode_worker_ram: The active model is estimated at {each} MB per copy, about {total} MB across the workers.
detection.region_override_desc: Some models come in regional versions. Auto follows the country in your location; choose one to override it.
detection.personalized_rerank_desc: Uses the species you corrected to adjust scores for each camera and model. Off uses the model's own scores.
detection.cuda_runtime_only: CUDA runtime installed (no NVIDIA GPU detected)
detection.model_manager_crop_policy_automatic_desc: YA-WAMF uses the crop policy tested for this model. There is nothing to tune when you switch models.
detection.model_manager_threshold_hint: Recommended naming threshold for this model:
detection.model_manager_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? This removes the files from disk. You can download it again later.
detection.model_manager_install_subtitle: Download, validate on your hardware, and enable this model.
detection.model_manager_install_note: Each step runs on your hardware. Nothing becomes active until validation passes.
detection.model_manager_device_set: Fastest verified provider: {provider}{ms}. It will be applied when this model is enabled.
detection.model_manager_validation_needed: Downloaded but not yet validated on your hardware. Validate it to confirm it runs here before you select it.
detection.model_manager_validate_ran_ok: Ran on {provider}{ms} and produced valid output.
detection.model_manager_provider_fallback_title: Automatic fallback in the order shown
detection.openvino_compile_failure: OpenVINO model incompatibility on this host
detection.openvino_compile_failure_detail: This model cannot compile on the currently selected OpenVINO device. YA-WAMF will keep the model installed but run inference on {fallback}.
detection.image_flavor_mismatch: The {provider} runtime is not included in the {flavor} image. Use the full image or a matching provider image, then recreate the container. CPU fallback remains available.
detection.compat_unverified: Not yet run on this host. Run the check to verify the providers available in this image.
detection.compat_test_subtitle: Validates every provider available to this image and model against the CPU baseline.
detection.worker_counts_desc: Each worker holds its own copy of the model. Leave empty for the default of one. Applied the next time the workers restart.
detection.video_concurrency_follows_workers: Clips are analysed as many at a time as there are background workers. The models classify one image per worker, so a separate concurrency setting could only queue jobs or starve workers.
detection.band_native_recovering: Waiting for isolated workers to resume classification.
detection.band_native_restart: Restart the container to release the stalled runtime.
detection.compat_all_hint: Downloads each one first, so the check takes much longer.
detection.compat_all_models: Also test models that are not installed
detection.compat_result_failed: Some devices failed validation. See the breakdown below.
detection.compat_result_ok: All devices match the CPU baseline.
detection.compat_result_skipped: Some devices could not be validated. See the breakdown below.
detection.compat_result_warn: All devices run, but some differ from the CPU baseline.
detection.compat_results_unavailable: Compatibility results could not be loaded. Please retry.
detection.runtime_refresh_failed: The check finished, but YA-WAMF could not read the runtime it is now using. Reload the page to see the current provider.
detection.compat_run: Check devices for every installed model
detection.compat_stage_run_hint: Compiling and comparing each device against the CPU baseline…
detection.model_manager_repair_needed: This model install is incomplete. Re-download it to restore the missing species names or model configuration before activation.
detection.model_manager_location_desc: This model also uses the feeder coordinates saved in {place}. If no valid coordinates are saved, it identifies birds without location. It does not use the date or a location accuracy radius.
detection.bird_finder_standard_desc: Small and quick. Misses many birds that are small in a wide frame.
detection.bird_finder_wide_desc: Reads the whole frame and four overlapping tiles, so it finds far more small and distant birds. Each frame takes longer.
detection.bird_finder_fallback: The wide-frame finder is not downloaded yet, so the standard finder is still in use. Download it below to switch.
detection.models_card_desc: Two models work in turn. The bird finder locates each bird in the camera frame; the identification model names its species.
detection.identification_desc: Names the species in each bird image. Larger models need more memory for every worker copy and take longer per image. Coverage differs: some know birds only, others birds and other wildlife.
detection.bird_finder_role: Locates each bird in the camera frame so YA-WAMF can crop and count it. It does not name the species.
detection.bird_finder_check_devices: Check devices for the bird finder
detection.bird_finder_check_devices_hint: Compares the finder on each device with the CPU on your saved bird photos, then uses the fastest that matches. The identification model is not changed.
detection.bird_finder_device_unpassed_saved_recove: Saved: {provider}. See Runs on above for the device currently used, or Check devices.
detection.bird_finder_check_devices_hint_rfdetr: Compares the finder on each device with the CPU on your saved bird photos, then prefers a passing NPU, followed by GPU, before CPU. The identification model is not changed.
detection.bird_finder_runs_not_downloaded: Nowhere yet · this finder is not downloaded
detection.bird_finder_runs_passed: {provider} · passed its device check on this host
detection.bird_finder_runs_failed_dated: CPU · {devices} failed the device check on {date}
detection.bird_finder_runs_cause_mismatch: {fact} (the boxes did not match the CPU's)
detection.bird_finder_runs_interrupted: CPU · the last check of {devices} was interrupted
detection.bird_finder_runs_waiting: CPU · waiting for saved bird photos to check {devices}
detection.bird_finder_runs_waiting_full_frames: CPU · waiting for full camera frames to check {devices}. The saved bird photos are close crops, and a finder cannot be checked on those.
detection.bird_finder_runs_never: CPU · no accelerator has passed a check on this host yet
detection.bird_finder_runs_cpu_only: CPU · this host offers the finder no accelerator
detection.bird_finder_device_unpassed_saved: Saved: {provider}. It runs on CPU until {provider} passes a check. Check devices, or choose Automatic.
detection.bird_finder_device_unpassed_chosen: {provider} has not passed a check for this finder on this host, so it cannot be saved yet. Check devices, or choose Automatic.
detection.bird_finder_repair_desc: Download the finder's files again if they are missing or damaged.
detection.bird_finder_how_save: A change of finder or device takes effect when you save. If the device becomes unavailable, a verified recovery device or CPU is used. The fast fallback finder picks its device automatically.
detection.bird_finder_pending: Save changes to switch the bird finder. The current finder keeps running until then.
detection.bird_finder_backup: If it cannot find a usable bird, YA-WAMF also tries the fast fallback finder and Frigate's tracking box, and uses the full frame only when none of them gives a reliable crop.
detection.acceptance_desc: How sure the identification model must be before a visit is saved under a species name.
detection.hardware_desc: Which device runs the models, and how much memory they may use. Auto picks the fastest device that passed the check on this host.
detection.compat_panel_desc: Runs the installed models on each device this image can use and compares the results with the CPU. Graphics and NPU devices are used only after they pass here.
detection.frigate_video_desc: Whether to use labels Frigate already has, write YA-WAMF species back to Frigate, and check recorded clips after the snapshot.
detection.threshold_help: At or above this score, a visit is saved under the species name.

llm.openrouter_model_hint: Enter any OpenRouter model ID (e.g. google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite). Browse models at openrouter.ai/models.
llm.enabled_desc: Lets you ask an AI provider to describe a visit from its record. Needs an API key from the provider, who bills each request.

explorer_view.label: Explorer layout
explorer_view.desc: The layout new devices start with. Cards show a snapshot for each visit; a list fits more on screen and lines the times up so you can scan for one. Each device can switch it from the Explorer, and that choice sticks on that device.

system_health.title: System
system_health.description: What this host is doing, and how much of it is this app.
system_health.cores: {count, plural, one {# core} other {# cores}}, no CPU limit on the container
system_health.cores_limited: {count, plural, one {# core} other {# cores}}, limited to {quota}
system_health.share_summary: This app {app} · rest of the host {other} · idle {idle}
system_health.role_other_host_note: Not this app. Cannot be named without the Docker socket.
system_health.note: CPU and memory are read from this container's own processes. Accelerator cells name the runtime a model worker actually loaded; NPU utilisation is device-wide and cannot be divided honestly between workers. Anything else on the host is measured only as the CPU remainder.
system_health.unavailable: Load history is not available right now.
system_health.empty: The first samples arrive a few seconds after start.
system_health.cpu_unmeasured: CPU load cannot be measured on this host; the counters it needs are not readable from inside the container.
system_health.no_accelerator: No accelerator counter is readable on this host, so only the CPU is drawn.
system_health.app_scope_note: GPU time is published per process, so that line is the work YA-WAMF sent to the GPU. Another container sharing the same GPU is not visible here.
system_health.measurement_gap: No utilisation reading for this sample. The worker rows below show their loaded accelerator; this gap does not establish a CPU fallback.
system_health.unreadable_nvidia: {label} is present, but its driver publishes no utilisation counter a container can read.
system_health.unreadable_accelerator: {label} is present, but its counter cannot be read from inside the container.
system_health.undrawn_accelerator: {label} is measured, but the chart draws three accelerators at most, so its line is left out.

text_size.label: Text size
text_size.desc: Makes every page larger or smaller on this device only. Large displays still grow a little on top of it.

beta.title: Beta features
beta.garden_animals_desc: Collects cats, foxes and other non-bird visitors from cameras you choose, for you to review.
beta.garden_naming_off: Every animal waits in Needs your call for you to confirm and name it.
beta.garden_naming_elsewhere: Automatic naming is set with the birds’ naming threshold, at the top of Identifying birds.
beta.garden_alerts_elsewhere: Garden animal alerts are set in {section}, with the channels they send through.
beta.garden_naming_threshold_help: This is a second check, on which animal it is. At or above it, the animal is confirmed and named for you. Below it, its photo goes to Dismissed, where you can restore it.
beta.garden_naming_threshold: Name an animal when this sure which one it is
beta.garden_requirements: Needs Frigate cameras that track animals or keep motion recordings. Garden downloads its own models only when you ask: 224 MB for automatic checks, plus optional 224 MB and 101 MB models. Your bird model is not changed.
beta.garden_models_help: Garden uses its own models, separate from your bird model. A download only adds a verified file. It saves no settings and starts no checks.
beta.garden_models_apply: Save changes to switch Garden on. Model status and downloads then appear here.
beta.garden_model_check_help: Checks every new capture, dismisses bird-only or empty photos and names confident animals. If it is missing, the first automatic check downloads it.
beta.garden_model_suggestions_help: Used when you choose Suggest species on a confirmed animal. Not needed for automatic checks.
beta.garden_model_motion_help: Finds animals in retained motion footage for cameras with motion photos turned on. Not needed for Frigate animal events.
beta.garden_model_downloading: Downloading and verifying. This can take up to three minutes; you can keep editing settings.
beta.garden_model_download_failed: The download could not be verified. Nothing was changed. Try again.
beta.garden_models_one_at_a_time: One download runs at a time.
beta.garden_models_busy: Garden is busy with a check, scan or download. Refresh the status in a minute.
beta.garden_models_error: Garden work is stopped until the application restarts.
beta.garden_models_status_needed: Downloads are available once the model status loads.
beta.garden_country_missing: No country is set, so animals are not named automatically and species suggestions are unavailable. Set your feeder’s location in {section}.
beta.garden_outcome_pending_review: Checks waiting to run, failed checks waiting for retry, missing setup or catalogue identity, and owner overrides.
beta.garden_outcome_confirmed: Animals you confirm, and confident animals named automatically. An automatic name is marked as automatic and can be discarded.
beta.garden_outcome_dismissed_low_score: Captures you dismiss, photos whose species score is below the naming threshold, and photos the check is confident show a bird you do not keep, nothing or a vehicle. Return to review restores one while its photo remains.
beta.garden_outcome_person: A capture with person evidence is removed with its photo. Garden visits never count as birds or reach bird notifications and exports.
beta.garden_explorer_help: New captures wait in the Explorer under Garden animals, Needs your call.
beta.garden_cameras_none: No camera watches for Garden animals yet.
beta.garden_motion_summary: Motion review photos are collected on {cameras}.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_help: Only for birds you keep. The bird model knows only wild species, so it names a hen as a Red Junglefowl. Birds added here are recorded as Garden animals, not wild birds, and are never sent to eBird, BirdWeather or iNaturalist.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_wild: Nothing counts as domestic until you add it. Mallards, Greylag Geese, Wild Turkeys and Rock Doves also live wild, so on every camera they are then recorded as your birds.
beta.garden_domestic_birds_none: None yet. Chickens and other birds you keep are treated as wild birds.
beta.garden_status_cameras: {count, plural, =0 {no camera chosen} one {# camera} other {# cameras}}
beta.garden_step_camera: Choose a camera to watch for Garden animals.
beta.garden_step_apply: Save changes to turn Garden on. Model and country checks then appear here.
beta.garden_step_location: Set your location, so Garden knows your country and can name animals.
beta.garden_off_note: Garden stops collecting new captures. Existing captures and settings are kept and come back when you turn it on again.
beta.garden_off_effects: While it is off, Garden is hidden in the Explorer, its alerts stop, and birds you keep are recorded as wild birds. History retention still applies to saved captures.
beta.garden_naming_help: Animals that reach the naming threshold are confirmed and named. Photos below it go to Dismissed, where you can restore them.
beta.garden_device_note: Automatic checks use the device chosen under {place} once it agrees with the CPU, and fall back to the CPU if it fails. Motion scans use the CPU. Garden runs one job at a time while birds and cameras are idle.
beta.garden_sentence_blocked_model: No check yet: the Garden model is not downloaded.
beta.garden_sentence_blocked_camera: No check yet: no camera watches for Garden animals.
beta.garden_sentence_last_check_fallback: Last check {time} on {device}, because the preferred device failed.
beta.garden_sentence_device_checked: Automatic checks run on {device}, which matched the CPU before its first use.
beta.garden_sentence_device_unused: Automatic checks will try {device} first. It has not run a check yet.
beta.garden_sentence_motion_unread: Motion photo status could not be read. Refresh to try again.
beta.garden_sentence_saved_crops: {count, plural, one {# crop} other {# crops}} saved of {limit, number} allowed.
beta.part_intro: Features still being tested. Each is off until you turn it on, and may change or be removed. Turning one off keeps what it has already recorded.

native_revalidation.title: Check quarantined profile
native_revalidation.description: Check a saved crash profile with your own bird photos and clip in a disposable worker. This names nothing and does not change your history.
native_revalidation.limits: Choose exactly three different photos, up to 25 MiB each, and one clip up to 32 MiB with at least three readable frames.
native_revalidation.acknowledge: I understand this runs native code and may crash the disposable worker.
native_revalidation.scope: Approval applies only to this exact profile until application restart. Saved crash evidence remains. Inputs are deleted after child cleanup. Leaving this page does not cancel a running check. If cleanup cannot be verified, private inputs remain for owner cleanup after restart.

range_filter.title: Range filter
range_filter.description: Sets aside automatic identifications of birds eBird has never recorded in your region, so a European species is not named at a Californian feeder.
range_filter.toggle: Check new visits against your region
range_filter.toggle_desc: Off by default. Applies to new visits only; nothing already recorded is changed.
range_filter.toggle_disabled_location: Set a location first. The filter needs it to know which region's birds to expect.
range_filter.status_active: Filtering to {count, plural, one {# species} other {# species}} recorded in {region} (eBird, refreshed {age}).
range_filter.status_ready: Off. Turning it on would filter to {count, plural, one {# species} other {# species}} recorded in {region}.
range_filter.status_needs_location_detail: The filter uses your feeder’s location, set in {section}, to find your eBird region.
range_filter.status_needs_key: Add an eBird API key to use range filtering.

range_filter.how_fallback: If the model's top answer has never been recorded in your region, its next answer that has been recorded, and still clears your naming threshold, is used instead. The record keeps a note of what the model said first.
range_filter.how_skip: If no answer qualifies, the visit is not recorded. It is listed below and on Health, so a genuine rarity can still be added by hand.
range_filter.how_open: Whenever the list is missing, out of date or unreachable, nothing is filtered.
range_filter.how_owner: Species you choose yourself are never filtered.
range_filter.preview_desc: What the filter would set aside with this list and the current model. Visits already recorded stay in your history.

visit_gap.label: Visit gap
visit_gap.range: From 5 to 300 seconds. The default is 60.

visit_gap.history: After you save, every page groups visits with the new gap. Days whose captures the history window has already removed keep the visit counts they were saved with.
